title: Twoody computer status v1
description: The `status` object a computer sends with POST /api/v1/account_computers/:id/heartbeat, the backend returns in GET /api/v1/account_computers, and a peer answers on GET /api/v1/peer/status (twoody-server docs/multi-computer-design.md §2-3). At most 4096 bytes once serialised as JSON. Readers ignore fields they do not know; writers send only these.

app_version.description: Version of the Twoody server or Desktop that answers.

models.description: Models this computer can answer with, exact runtime names.

gpu_pct.description: null when the machine has no GPU the sampler can read.

at.description: ISO 8601 time of the sample, null when none was taken yet.

tps.description: Median generation speed (tokens per second) measured per model; a model never measured is absent.

inflight.description: Generations running now (chat and background together).

accepts.description: Purposes a peer may send it; empty means it takes none.

tools.description: Its models may be called with OpenAI tools.

engine.description: Optional: the engine its « Moteur » preference resolves to (twoody-server docs/builtin-runtime-design.md §4), null when none answers. Readers ignore a value they do not know.

data_at_rest.description: Optional, only in the answer to another computer of the person (GET /api/v1/peer/status), never in the heartbeat to the account: whether its data folder is on an encrypted volume (twoody-server src/dataAtRest.ts). Readers ignore a value they do not know.
